086        this.modificationType = raw[13];
087        this.startTime = Bytes.readShort(raw, 14);
088        this.basalRate = Bytes.readShort(raw, 16);

095    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int idp, int status, int segmentIndex, int modificationType, int startTime, int basalRate, int isf, long targetBg, int carbRatio) {
096        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
097            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(68, 0),
098            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
099            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
100            new byte[]{ (byte) idp }, 
101            new byte[]{ (byte) status }, 
102            new byte[]{ (byte) segmentIndex }, 
103            new byte[]{ (byte) modificationType }, 
104            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(startTime), 
105            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(basalRate), 
106            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(isf), 
107            Bytes.toUint32(targetBg), 
108            new byte[]{ (byte) carbRatio }));
109    }
